No P1/P2 bugs found in the supplied owned-content conversion code and regression tests.

### Verification Summary
1. **Token Separation (`localizeLessonCode`)**:
   - The regex `/#[^\n]*|"""[\s\S]*?"""|'''[\s\S]*?'''|"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|'(?:\\.|[^'\\])*'|[\p{L}_][\p{L}\p{N}_]*/gu` cleanly tokenizes Python comments, triple-quoted strings, single-quoted strings, and Unicode identifiers in a single pass without overlapping.
   - Comments (`#...`) are returned untouched.
   - Triple-quoted strings (`"""..."""`, `'''...'''`) fail the `/^(["'])([도레미파솔라시][#b]?(?:-?\d+)?)\1$/` check (since their body begins with quotes) and are preserved untouched.
   - Single- and double-quoted strings are only converted when the entire literal is an exact note specification (`[도레미파솔라시][#b]?(?:-?\d+)?`), preserving unrelated Korean strings like `"도형 라벨"` as well as octaves, sharps (`#`), flats (`b`), and negative octaves (`-1`).
   - Identifiers are looked up via `Object.hasOwn(englishCommands, token)`, preventing `Object.prototype` collisions (e.g., `constructor`, `toString`) while preserving Korean variable names (`도 = 3`) and existing `play_note` calls.

2. **Course Traversal & Immutability (`localizeCourse`)**:
   - Source fields (`code`, `accessibleCode`) are routed to `localizeLessonCode`, while non-translated metadata/code fields (`supportCode`, `copyCode`, `signature`, `url`, `path`, `id`, `ko`, `en`) are preserved verbatim.
   - Course objects and arrays are shallow-cloned at every visited level without mutating the source dataset, verified by the snapshot equality check in the regression suite.

3. **Regression Coverage**:
   - All edge cases from the previous critique (octaves/accidentals, preserving `play_note`, comments, unrelated strings, `Object.prototype` keys, and workbook immutability) are directly covered and pass against the implementation.
